title: Public Alert No. 017/2026 – Alert on Confirmed Counterfeit of Herceptin 600 mg in Nigeria
summary: NAFDAC confirms a counterfeit batch of Herceptin 600 mg (batch A8519B34) circulating in Lagos, Nigeria. Roche Nigeria found wrong artwork, wrong expiry date and incorrect 2D matrix code; the batch number is not genuine. Counterfeit oncology drugs risk treatment failure or death.
